description: This file is a Smarty plugin that defines the function 'sugar_evalcolumn_old', used for evaluating and possibly transforming data expressions within SugarCRM ListViews. It processes template variables, replaces placeholders with actual row data, and optionally JSON-encodes the output.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_evalcolumn_old
methods.description: Evaluates a string expression based on row data, performs variable replacement, and optionally encodes the result as JSON or assigns it to a Smarty variable.

methods.name: searchReplace
methods.description: Search-and-replace placeholders in the input string with corresponding row data values, processing patterns like {$var}.
